title: Direct send of the ENTIRE remaining period budget
instruction: Pay your ENTIRE remaining period budget in USDC to {recipient} on Base Sepolia, then tell me what happened and what your budget looks like now.

source.note: The amount derives from a LIVE enforcer read, never a hardcoded number (#2016) — this task inherits that discipline from the agent side: the agent must discover its own remaining budget (haven_get_allowances) and the grader pins the transfer to the live remaining figure the runner resolved for THIS trial (#3992 A2). Tier 2: the budget drainer — it runs ONE trial (after it, nothing is left to drain), after every tier-1 task and before the tier-3 exhausted-budget tasks.
